business_problem: epaka.pl was making marketing and operational decisions from partial, delayed reports and needed a single trusted data foundation that could unify online and offline order data in real time and support churn prediction.
solution_summary: epaka.pl uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: epaka.pl was making marketing and operational decisions from partial, delayed reports and needed a single trusted data foundation that could unify online and offline order data in real time and support churn prediction. BigQuery acts as the company’s data brain by unifying order data from online channels and more than 300 offline locations, serving as the storage layer. Looker delivers real-time dashboards and self-service reporting on top of the unified data foundation, serving as the serving layer. BigQuery ML predicts churn risk from historical customer behavior and transactional signals, serving as the compute layer. Order and transactional data from online channels and hundreds of offline locations is centralized in BigQuery, Looker reads that foundation in real time for reporting and monitoring, and BigQuery ML scores churn risk so commercial teams can act before customers leave.
